course.title: Engineering Economy
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: Two processes can be used for producing a polymer that reduces friction loss in engines. Process-T will have a first cost of \$750,000, an operating cost of \$60,000 per year, and a savage value of \$80,000 after its 2 years life. Process W will have a first cost of \$1,350,000, an operating cost of \$25,000 per year, and a \$120,000 savage value after its 4 vears life, Process W will also require updating at the end of year 2 at a cost of \$90,000. Which process should be selected on the basis of a future worth analysis at an interest rate of 12% per year?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
